findings.title: Fallback locale files are only loaded for controller requests
findings.body: The new fallback chain depends on `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` to load the site-default and English locale files, but this call is made only from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Mailers, background jobs, console scripts, and any other non-controller use of `I18n.t` still have the translate accelerator load only `I18n.locale`. When a key is absent in that locale, the fallback backend searches an unloaded fallback locale and returns a missing translation even when the translation exists in its YAML file. The fallback locales need to be loaded as part of the fallback lookup/translation path (or otherwise for every I18n locale context), rather than only during HTTP controller setup.
